title: Pyrefly: A Fast Static Type Checker for Python Projects
description: Learn how to use Pyrefly, a fast static type checker for Python, to catch type errors, generate type annotations, and measure type coverage.
summary: Pyrefly is a fast static type checker for Python that helps you catch type-related issues before running your code. It also includes features for generating type hints and measuring type coverage across a codebase.
